description: Self-hosted monitoring for Avalanche C-Chain and Fuji using the upstream network examples for chain IDs 43114 and 43113; operators provide hosting and RPC access.

Self-hosted development interface for roles, permissions and administrative actions on compatible Ownable/AccessControl contracts on Avalanche Fuji; currently in development, with production/mainnet availability not claimed and external RPC, explorer, indexer, hosting and transaction costs separate.
